company_info.company_description: "Renewable energy and sustainability is not only our job, but our passion.We strive to help people reduce their carbon footprint with the added bonus of saving some money along the way. We don't aim to sell you the biggest system we possibly can, we aim to sell you the best system that will suit your needs. Customer satisfaction is of utmost importance to us.We provide you with all the information to help you understand what set up will benefit you and your family the most. We follow up our installation with support to ensure your system operates as best it can.We analyse your energy usage and not only help you reduce it with our solar installations, but offer our expertise on how you can reduce it in other aspects as well.We are your smart monitoring experts. Smart monitoring delivers detailed reporting on the health of your system so you know just how it is operating every single day, all through a simple app on your phone.We use the best quality products at a very competitive price to ensure you get great value and the best possible efficiency and lifespan from your system."

reviews.review_description: The day I received the names of the three solar installers,Nathan from ZENECO phoned, arranged a visit that afternoon and emailed three quotes that same evening which I requested for various comparisons.He was very informative as well as climbing onto the roof to check where the equipment would best be located.After accepting the quote ,installation occurred within 2 weeks and the grid connection organised (still waiting for Origin to complete).Of the other 2 installers, one did not visit but provided a competitive quote, the other sent a rep to pepper me with all sorts of questions-this quote was the dearest and didn't address my requirements....he was very rigid in his advice and informed me that I would need to pay Ausgrid a feed in tariff.

Nathan, Ted and the team at Zeneco did a great job with recent solar install. They were the only supplier who did an onsite inspection as part of quote process and communication has been excellent. Pricing was competitive and install was clean and efficient. Nathan has promptly answered my queries throughout the whole process and post install and I feel confident in their after sales support. I would recommend Zeneco and look forward to reaping the benefits of our new solar system.

Nathan and his team at Zeneco provided me an all-round great experience. Zeneco Energy provided competitive pricing, but more than that was very open and honest with the proposal for our solar system. Nathan was prompt in answering all my questions which left me feeling very comfortable in my decisions. When it came to the installation, the team from Zeneco Energy were very respectful of my property and completed a very tidy install. I would highly recommend this company.
Had Nathan and his professional team install my 13 kw system today  looks great and works better highly recommended

Overall happy with most aspects of our solar installation . Zeneco offered quality products at a reasonable price and were professional during and after install . Would be happy to recommend them to other potential customers
Quick response, detailed quote. Came early as there was a cancellation
Nathan from Zeneco Energy was outstanding! Prompt quote, very competitive price, on time and easy to deal with.Zeneco were fantastic! We could not be happier?
Sales and quoting process was easy and Nathan was readily available to contact, eagerly accomodating and helpful.Installation was carried out punctually, quickly, politely, and effectively.
Punctual competitive quotes, quick installation and grid connection, friendly service and zeneco advantage.  Very satisfied.

We chose Zeneco Energy because they are local to the Central Coast NSW, had 5 star reviews, used products on the Solar Quotes lists and the owner, Nathan, an electrician, did the quote, as opposed to a salesman.Installation day was smooth and professional. Nathan organised admin re our provider, Red Energy.

After a lot of research we chose a local company, Zeneco Energy, to install our 6.6kw solar system. We got lots of widely varying quotes, from one who looked at the site on Google Earth and rang us to say there were too many trees and they wouldn't bother, to another who offered an almost identical deal to Zeneco but was almost twice the price. Zeneco were not one of the dirt cheap ones you see on TV but supplied quality product and backup services at a very competitive price. Nathan took us patiently through all the technical ins and outs of the varying options without any 'hard sell' and was the only one to actually get up on the roof and take various readings. On installation day the team (not contractors, employees) arrived on time and completed the job without any fuss, they were also very friendly and did a bit of extra work to reposition the TV aerial. So far we have had cloudy days but the outputs have exceeded what i expected and I am very happy with Zeneco.

This provider was the only one who was willing to come my house to talk things through ( the other companies were wanting me to commit without visiting my home) . Installation was quick, staff were friendly and polite and the job was done quickly. I am happy to recommend this company ?

After a review of the quotes, I received from 3 companies recommended by Solar Quotes plus 2 from friends I decided to upscale from a 6.6kw System to a 13.2kw system. The quote provided by Zeneco for a basic system was only slightly higher than the most expensive 6.6kw system ($1000), they got my interest and after to and froing emails I decided to go with the basic system but upgrade to a Sungrow Inverter for another $1000. I found emails the best way to communicate, they were always answered promptly. Installation was 5weeks after payment of deposit with one small reschedule of a couple days. The installation team were professional, polite and tidy, it took about 6hrs to install the system. Tested it on the first day and it produced 79kWh, I then received and email from my power supplier informing me that the system should be turned off until the smart meter had been installed as it could cause the existing meter to run backwards. DARN, so I'm waiting for and installation, 2 to 3 weeks (hope that is wrong) frustrating investing all that money and not being able to get the returns it can produce. My installation was pretty straight forward, big colorbond roof with 2 aspects east and west and would recommend Zeneco  for their value, competence and professionalism.

The initial visit was within a few days of requesting a quote and Nathan provided advice on the most suitable system for us. We also had one other quote and with no site visit we did not follow this up.The installation team were very professional and we are happy with the end result.  The system was installed within the original program provided.

We chose Zeneco to install our solar panels and have been very happy with our decision. Nathan was prompt, friendly and informative. As he was most informative and thorough of the three people we consulted we easily decided on Zeneco.  Nathan was responsive in his communications and on the day installation was efficient and went smoothly. Could not fault the whole process and would happily recommend Zeneco.

The Zeneco team were friendly and polite.  They worked very efficiently and gave me updates along the way. I was able to work from home during the installation with only a short time without power.  The end result is amazing, the panels are not noticeable from the street, but are so neat it would not matter if they were.  The presales were very helpful allowing me to go with a system that suited both my needs and budget. I was given all the various options but was guided away from add-ons that sounded cool but were not necessary based on my usage.  I could not recommend this company enough. Thanks!

The quoting process was very precise a I knew exactly what I did and did not want.The installation process was punctual and the installers very polite etc.Zeneco also organized installation of the Smart Meter after I had difficulty getting my energy retailer Red Energy to do it.

They turned up when they said they would for the quote. There was no hard sell. Just gave a good description of the produces they use.Installed on the day they said they would. Cleaned up and left no mess.Explained the operation of the system to us. Which has been working well.

In a nutshellThe whole process was flawless.The salesperson was prompt, polite, respectful and factual.The install commenced in a reasonable amount of time with any delays noted ahead of time.The install went well and on time, the work was tidy, and the premises was left clean.The post install process was well managed and is ongoing to provide after sales support.Overall, a good experience. I would recommend Zeneco energy.

I had to initially chase a quote, however. The owner Nathan had just had a child and still managed to respond to my email after hours! After receiving the quote, he gave the most competitive rate and was the most likable of all the installers I dealt with. The installation went perfectly, Nathan was polite, in his work uniform and even arrived a little early! Customer service deserves 6 stars. Nathan is going out of his way to make sure we fully understand everything about solar and our new system. He also contacted our energy provider on our behalf so there was nothing extra we had to do!

After extensive research and lots of quotes, I finally decided to go ahead with Zeneco and today after installation completion I am fully satisfied with my decision. From the first meet till today I found Nathan, Michael, Matt and team very professional, confident, very approachable and great in communication. Zeneco was one of the handfuls who actually visited my place for a solar review and were only one who measured and inspected the roof for a correct fit system. Matt gave expert advice on which solution is best fit and great suggestions about which panel/inverter vendors to select and which to avoid. The recommendation was based on facts and no sales pitch at all. Nathan was very quick to provide quote and answered all my queries promptly. The quote itself was very competitive and other providers could not beat it. Michael, Matt and team were on time on the day of installation, done a great job and cleaned up later. Paperwork was handed over with all details. Overall highly satisfied with the service!!

Had a really great experience with Nathan and the local team at Zeneco. They came out to our place and were the only company of 4 who actually got up on the roof and had a look around. it was a complex install with east/north/west facing panels. They provided some recommendation and a price for the system that was at the lower end compared with my other quotes.I requested a price on a Hauwei + Trina system which Nathan was happy to supply. After weighing the options, we settled on a Hauwei L1 inverter and Trina Vertex S+ panels and set an install date. The online contract signing made things easy.Wet weather delayed our install a few times. This was one area where communication could have been a bit better. A confirmation on the morning if the install was going ahead or not would have been helpful. However, with the uncertain weather the past few months, I was happy to be flexible.On install day, the team showed up and performed all the work to a great quality standard. The inverter looks neat and tidy in the garage, the panels look great, and everything was labelled clearly. The team left everything tidy and I received the STC paperwork the same day.The system has been working just as expected without any issues. The monitoring hardware and app enable us to measure solar output and electricity usage, which is helpful for planning for self consumption.Overall, we are very happy with the service Zeneco Energy provided. They worked with us to design a system for our needs. The install went smoothly and it's been working great. Highly recommended!

The sales process was very comprehensive, and Nathan gave good advice around the use of a hot water timer, rather than an expensive hot water relay.They had supply chain issues (very common at the moment), with 3 re-schedules and a little bit of a breakdown in communication regarding when things would be happening.However, once things were underway, it was a swift, efficient and professional process.They were also provided good after installation support when requested.Overall, I would recommend Zeneco as a solar supplier / installer.

After a long search, we found Zeneco and within a few days, the team were on site to put together a quote. Out of all installers we spoke with, Zeneco were the only team to get onto the roof to put together a fully informed quote.The installation was completed in just over a day with a very polite and professional team attending. The site was left clean and we were fully informed of what was going to be happening.I couldn’t fault the customer service. As a family run business, it is so clear the commitment and dedication put in. No question was too silly and the team worked with us which was a great feeling.I would not hesitate to recommend Zeneco. I was extremely impressed in the quality and professionalism of the whole process - quoting to install.

Nathan was the only installer to climb onto the roof before giving me a quote. He was able to answer all my questions and gave accurate information regarding the products used and their performance.His install team were polite and confirmed with me the placement of the inverter before installation.They turned up onsite when they said they would and cleaned up as they worked. Very professional company.

What a great company, Nathan, Michael and the team are fantastic, Hassel free from the start, They even came out and got on my roof and measured the area for the panels, none of this google earth quotes, The weather was not good come install time, but the boys did there best between rain and Michael called me daily to keep me updated, Highly recommend Zeneco for all solar installs, Extremely happy

Nathan come to my home and climbed the roof measured the roof area and then we sat down and decided which unit to install. The 7.8kw unit was decided and date was set to be installed.On the day of installment 3 tradesmen and a apprentice showed up and started to install the panels and the inverter.Being a retired electrician my self these tradesmen were fantastic with their work ethics and took great effort with their safety while the installation was done. Well done Zeneco Energy team.P.S. the only problem we have I cannot use the solar because I'm waiting for the installment of the smart meter hopping it wont take too long.

Nathan and his team from Zeneco Energy installed our 6.6kw Solar System this month.  Nathan was the only Solar installer who actually got on our roof to work out the best arrangement of solar panels for our home.  I found their price was very reasonable for a good quality system that should serve us for many years ahead. On installation day the team arrived on time, they were very pleasant and polite young men.  They worked well together installing our system and they kept me informed about the process.  We are very happy with the service we got from Zeneco Energy and would not hesitate to recommend them to others.  Thank you Zeneco Energy.

Very impressed with Nathan and the team.Very good service and very professional, they answered every question and addressed every concern we had before starting.The installation was very smooth and the team is very friendly.We just received our first bill ... and it was credit.

I recently selected Zeneco Energy to instal my solar system and am very happy with it.Throughout the proposal and installation process Nathan was hands on in assessing my property onsite, up on the roofs, as well as shading impacts. This was crucial to me in terms of getting the right design and to avoid major changes at the point of installation. Having someone relatively local to provide support and other electrical services in the future was also important.Nathan offered different options to meet my needs to reduce my large electricity bill and to future proof where possible so I could have an EV charger installed.He provided what I think was more realistic analysis of estimated solar production against my actual electricity usage and bills, which seemed to be borne out in initial experience.I have no hesitation in recommending Nathan and his team at Zeneco Energy.Thanks to Nathan and his team for a quality installation and patience in answering all my questions!Thanks also to the Solarquotes team for all your research and leading me to Zeneco Energy.
The quoting process, installation, punctuality, customer service and grid connection was extremely professional and a minimum of 5 stars all round.
Great experience in pre and post sales installation of our new solar system.Nathan is clearly an expert in the product and provided excellent service.

Nathan was great to deal with, although not the cheapest, I knew what I was getting and Nathan knew what was required as he spent the time doing a site inspection so no surprises would arise on installation day. Communication was great and despite some bad weather the installation was done in a timely manner. Great Work Nathan and team!!

From the quote process to final delivery, Nathan and his team have answered all the questions I had and addressed all the concerns before installation. The install went smoothly and they left the site neat and clean.Very professional and personal.  It's good to see a team take pride in their work.I would recommend Zeneco any day!
Would recommend Zeneco to anyone. On time .On budget. No problems what so ever.

Got three quotes from solar quotes installers and Zeneco provided the best solution (imo) at best price.  The install was done quickly and pre and post install support has been great. Made the whole process of getting solar very easy.
Very impressed with the service from Zeneco Energy. Great price, excellent service, and very professional. Would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a solar installer.

The quoting process was very straight forward and Nathan provided a quote and a technical solution that met our requirements and needs. At the site vist before installation we were able to discuss and adjust positively the system. The installation went smoothky and the team was very professional and tidy. Nathan has always been happy to answer any questions.

Nathan and his team at Zeneco were recommended to me by a friend who also used.  He was a extremely professional and courteous solar contractor who did an excellent job at what I regards as a very good price.  Quality and Value mattered to me and that is what I was given.Thanks to Nathan and his team who installed the system very efficiently in a day and left the site very tidy and removed all the packaging rubbish.I would have no hesitation in recommending Zeneco to others who were looking to install solar.

Quoting---Nathan was polite, informative and was able to answer my questions. I had many of them for him.Installation---The boys were polite, did a good job and cleaned up everything after themselvesCustomer Service---Nathan went out of his way to help with the grid, app and wi-fi connections. He sorted out a couple ofissues promptly. I couldn't have asked for better after sales service.
Nathan was a pleasure to deal with from initial contact through to installation highly recommend Zeneco.

Nathan and his team were great to deal with. He came out to quote and advise on the best system and answered all my questions. They were very punctual on install day. After install He stayed back extra time to finish the set up and talk me through the system and the app!System has been on for a couple of days now and I’m stoked!Very happy and will recommend to anyone looking to install solar!
Very informative, system clearly explained. No problems, installer made sure I was fully aware of the process. In the process of, only installed today, returning tomorrow.
Whole process was seamless. From first contact to installation. Quick to come out and have a look and back with a quote the same day.  Would definitely recommend Zeneco Energy
Excellent: they were all of the above. Please read my comments under "Other"

First contact with Nathan was by phone shortly after requesting quotes. He did a site inspection and quote with a week. I found him to be professional, informative, punctual, personable and very passionate about solar energy.The install had to rescheduled 2 times due to Covid lockdown restrictions, but we were kept informed at all times.On the day of installation, Nathan and his team of 3 arrived at the nominated time, were very polite. I was included in the decision making process of where the inverter and hot water controller were to be placed, even though it involved more work on their part. The installation appeared to very professional and tidy ( as per Finn's video post on SolarQuotes), All my questions were answered by Nathan and his team, with the clean up being completed before leaving the site.I would not hesitate recommending Zeneco Energy to anyone in our area who is considering the installation of solar.The price was very competitive with other larger companies but I chose this small local business because of the punctuality, professionalism and passion of the owner, and I felt that after sales service, if required, would be easier than a large company where I was just a number.

A visit received within 24 hours and quote same day. Installation was 10 days later. Extremely polite and obliging installers.Customer services was exceptional with our questions responded to in a prompt and friendly manner.Highly recommended.

Nathan of Zeneco was prompt with the quote, approachable, and extremely knowledgeable about the products he installs.He gave me several options on installations and there was no pressure on which one to choose.On installation day, Nathan and his crew could not have been more Efficient. They were industrious, organized, and extremely respectful of our property. After being in the building and construction industry for 30years I was very impressed with their attention to detail. They all took pride in what they did and it was a pleasure to hear workers enjoying their tasks, even when Nathan left the site to go to another job the guys worked at the same pace. At the finish of the job their clean-up was beyond expectation again their attention to detail was outstanding. I would highly recommend Zeneco Energy to anyone wanting a quality and reasonably priced Solar Installation. Thank you Zeneco Energy.

Nathan and his team were excellent. Right from the onset, Nathan was punctual and excelled in the quoting process.Zeneco Energy identified the optimal system for our location and delivered the best system for our situation.His team were highly professional and a great bunch of blokes to have around when doing the installation.When unintended issues arose, Nathan was upfront and honest and these issues were quickly resolved.They organised the grid and smart meter connection making it effortless for us.I am elated with my installation and have fallen in love with it. My wife and I are watching the dollars roll in as we save money on our power bill.We strongly recommend that you consider Zenco Energy for your Solar System installation.

Nathan quoted overnight after calling me to discuss the price and product quality. He provided a prompt quote and communicated clearly around price and installation.His installation team were excellent: punctual, tidy, polite and provided a very neat job. to deal with.We used the newer Jinko panels (20 year warranty and amazingly low degradation), with Sungrow 3 phase 10KW inverter. Nathan's price was way below other local retailers and was no problem when I switched from single to 3 phase. Nathan organised the meter change and his customer service was flawless.Many thanks to Nathan and the team for a fantastic experience - very happy customer.

Zeneco made the sale and quoting process easy and catered for our requirements. Other quotes were provided via desktop assessment with no input from us.The install was seamless and conducted in one day. The team was very professional and organised the grid connection for us on completion.

Zeneco was prompt, factual and professional. They provided good follow up on any questions we had and the installation was neat and tidy. They were also willing to do additional power board upgrades that were requested while they had electricians onsite. Whilst the system is only two weeks old, all appears to be working well.

Nathan was the only installer who came on site which was very much appreciated. His price was fair and reasonable and he answered any queries i had about the system. We organised an installation date that suited both of us and he and his team were very professional both with the installation to cleaning up etc. This was very much appreciated.

Nathan and his team did a fantastic job. Nathan was extremely helpful, knowledgable and covered all my questions along with being very patient as I did mind changes on which direction to go. Not either pushing the products or service which was a welcome change from other solar companies. When I finally settled on a proposal, the date was quickly arranged and the installation was efficiently done, no fuss, no mess, no drama. The system is great and I'm extremely happy with the whole experience. Highly recommend!!

Nathan reached out almost immediately after I submitted my request for quotes through SolarQuotes. I received 5 quotes in total. Zeneco were not the cheapest but their reviews were far better than the others, and the reviews of the quoted system components were also better.I felt Nathan listened to what I was asking for with regards to my particular requirements, and tailored the solution to meet that end.The team turned up at the scheduled time, were very pleasant, finished on time and the place was spotless. Very pleased with the experience, if only all tradies were as good. Would happily recommend.

Sales/quoting process was easy and our many questions were answered clearly.Installation went very smoothly with the team working seamlessly together.Nathan and all his team were very polite, tidy, punctual and a pleasure to work with.Nathan organised all our necessary paperwork and grid connection will take place in about 10 days.Would recommend Zeneco Energy to anyone who requires Solar!

Can't recommend Nathan and team highly enough! He came to my house and discussed my needs with me, and just after 2 weeks later I have solar system working on my roof and plugged into the grid. Sent me a really competitive quote, more than a month quicker than the others, was very personable, and they had great reviews already. Was very confident in them and they didn't disappoint.The 5 years servicing is great and they go above and beyond to make sure you have a great experience. Even ran some extra cable for me when they didn't need to. These guys really care, install quality looks great, and my whole system was up and running by the afternoon. Stoked.

Zeneco, was the third solar quote we obtained for our home, we had done much research on the panels and inverter we wanted to use, when Nathan came to quote our job he he applauded our research and did sway us to a better inverter, he was also the only person to actually look at our roof and advise the best system for us, there was a delay from our end with the install and Nathan was more than accommodating with our delay. When it comes to the install, it is nothing short of first class. I cannot fault any of the workmanship by Zeneco. After sales service is top level like the rest of the job. Faultless.

Zeneco Energy installed our solar panels and inverter. The process was seamless from start to go and they were super easy to deal with and their communication was great. Very happy with our product and service.

The quotation process was easy and quick had all the detail I requested. The install was quick, efficient, and the gents was super professional and great to work with. On time and very polite. Customer service was great kept me updated all the time on the progress of each step. Would definitely recommend them!
The quote was very reasonableThe installers were punctual and performed very professionallyThe activation was very quick
Great team. Great value for money. A pleasure to deal with. Thanks Nathan and team.

ZENECO is a great company to have install your solar. There work ethics are wonderful and are all friendly. Nathan and his crew will go out of there way to accommodate you .They have organised the new meter with Ausgrid.Set up the  Wi-Fi for monitoring  for us.

Very impressed with Zeneco Energy. Nathan first met onsite to inspect our roof, measure and provide a very competitive quote. All questions were answered and it was a big benefit to work directly with a local operator. Today’s installation was on time, as planned, and the team are pros. I can recommend Zeneco.

We found Nathan & the team great to deal with, he was very responsive to our requests and provided a system that met our size requirements and pricing expectationShowed up on time and finished installation within the same day with a very tidy install
Got in and got the job done when said they would,

From the time we started the daunting journey of finding a system & installer, we were always aware of potential pitfalls.We were so lucky we found Zeneco as the right fit for us. The quote was more than competitive, and with them being a smaller operation, was happy to hand the job to a local, small business.The customer service was fantastic as weather ( and Xmas approaching), put pressure on installation. However we were always kept in the loop, and it fell into place.Could not be happier with our system, and highly recommend Zeneco as an installer.

We have just had solar installed at our house and the result is fantastic. Nathan and his team have been nothing but professional from start to finish. Right from the beginning Nathan's knowledge and expertise was very evident. Out of four quoting companies he was the only one who took the time to verify all the satellite, sun and shade data with a hands on "on the roof" site inspection. He discussed all our options beforehand, and didnt try and sell us more panels than we needed or could be safely installed. The team arrived on time and had the job done in a timely manner. The result was a state of the art system with excellent energy production at a great price (already paying for itself!) and ongoing support from a trusted local company. I work as a  firefighter and I would not hesitate to recommend Nathan and the team at Zeneco energy to install your solar, particularly as I'm aware firsthand, that the solar industry is not always as it seems.

Before we spoke with Nathan at Zeneco Energy we didn't have the confidence to go ahead with a solar installer.We would highly recommend that you speak with Nathan before you engage another installer, to compare your products and advice.Nathan came to our home to check the site, explained everything to us in simple language and gave us some options to think about.He communicated well and was always available to take my enquiries. He was punctual and he and his team were friendly, and professional. The site was left very tidy and we wouldn't have known they'd been here except for the panels on the roof.

Zeneco Energy = Perfection Personified!, Truly A-Grade and 5 Star, truly 10 Star.Zeneco Energy, Nathan and his team, what a true professional Solar vendor, totally open, transparent and upfront, truthful and honest, from initial contact, scope definition, pre installation discussions, fine tuning, and then advancing to the installation and commissioning, Zeneco is the benchmark company and team to deal with, and not to mention extremly sharp on the pricing aspect.Over the initial discussions as to the size and system componentry, Nathan from Zeneco Energy was on point every day, every question I asked, there was a quick reply and adjustment to the scope, and was totally unbiased nor product based, Nathan was focussed on delivering the best Solar system to you as the customer.I am in awe of Zeneco Energy / Nathan and what he bought to the table, truly amazed, and especially the technical prowess is refreshing.The installation workmanship and attention to detail from the roof panel installation to the inverter installation, and associated cabling was craftsman’s grade, above and beyond what I had expected.The amazing experience continued to an operational and training aspect, where you as the customer were skilled on the installed system and how to maximise the true benefits to you home and consumption profile. This was followed up with detailed documentation.The system was a complex installation as it required transition from single phase to 3 phase, smart meter upgrade, sub board upgrade and load balancing across all phases.And the final degree of difficulty was to integrate the new 15.4 kW system, with the existing 3.8kW solar system,  Zeneco Energy achieved this seamlessly, and both systems and Energy consumption / generation monitoring is working perfectly.Zeneco Energy are you’re A-Grade single point of call for all your Solar requirements, these guys care, and are not box droppers, they are solution architects.My roof is a true piece of very functional technical art, delivering the maximum solar return thanks to Nathan. His team, and Zeneco Energy.

Zeneco Energy were the only supplier who actually carried out a site visit and spent time discussing the Pro's & Con's of various systems.The installation Team was great, we were kept updated with the work schedule and any issues occurring during the install. The entire team were very polite and went out of their way to ensure minimal disturbance to our normal activities.They removed all rubbish from site, assisted us to connect to the monitoring system and explained how to us the  Monitoring APP and website.Zeneco completed all the necessary paper work and submitted the necessary grid connection documents at completion of the works.I would recommend speaking to Nathan before signing any installation contract with other suppliers.

Nathan and his team did a brilliant job. Our panels are not in the normal best facing direction so we decided on a 28 panel 9.8kwh system. Sunday the 6th we produced 67.23kwh and Sunday the 7th we produced 58.97kwh. The service and system production far exceeded our expectations for a good price.

Zeneco made the process of solar installation to my home as worry free as you could imagine, the design and quote process was a breeze and the installation was of high quality.Very satisfied with the experience and happy that Solar quotes was able to connect myself with Zeneco.

My wife and I found Nathan and his team to be very professional and the installation was quick and efficient. Took only half a day to get power flowing to my house and the grid. Nathan from the start of the process corresponded well and was open with all information he provided on possible systems. He highlighted some points about our system and installation that others did not so definitely has a great knowledge of the systems and process. As I had some shading issues he organised a shade analysis which was useful to reassure me that there would be no major issues.  I would recommend Zeneco to anyone looking to get a solar system.  Thank you for your good work.

A pleasure to deal with from start to finish. We had a few quotes but it takes an electrician to give the correct information for our site.Nathan kept us up to date on what was happening and great tradies who were wonderful on site. We did not have to do a thing all Grid connection etc was done by Zeneco Energy. We would recommend Zeneco Energy to anyone looking for solar!

I found the Zeneco team diligent and professional. The director Nathan had a good understanding of the solar market and it's products. He answered all of my questions in a understandable way.  I found Nathan to be a straight up guy with an embracing laugh. Highly recommended company.
Only installer who turned up to look at the place. Simple quote that was easy to understand.Nathan organised everything with the power companySo far delivering everything he said it it. Thanks

After receiving 9 quote's  Nathan's friendly professional  help, and problem solving  gave me confidence to sign with Zeneco Energy. Nathan listened, understood and advised accordingly. Nathan, Damian and the team did a great job from the getgo.  No fuss no hassle all problems and aspects taken care of.Would definitely recommend.PS  be very, very mindful of the know it all companies out there with 'cowboy' salespeople.

We live on a battle ax block. We got 5 quotes and Nathan was the only one that talked to us about the distance between our meterbox and house and what resistance there’d be with sending our power back to the grid if we went with our original plan. Very honest and helpful.Installers were great. Very efficient and easy to deal with.
